requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) Design something useful. Make a sketch or model of your design. With your counselor's approval, create a promotional piece for the item using a picture or pictures. (b) Tell a story with a picture or pictures or using a 3-D rendering. (c) Design a logo. Share your design with your counselor and explain the significance of your logo. Then, with your parent or guardian's permission and your counselor's approval, put your logo on Scout equipment, furniture, ceramics, or fabric.
